Hi Kyle / Lisa —

Thanks again for the demo earlier. Quick recap and suggested next steps so procurement can move quickly: 

Recap (what Helix said matters for success):
- Quality: 95th-percentile response accuracy on our 50 test prompts (you mentioned 90% baseline).
- Volume: target ~800 daily API calls during trial peak (estimate ~350k tokens/day).
- Latency: sub-300ms p50 for single-turn queries is preferred for your UX.

Procurement options we discussed (please confirm preferred):
1) Card (self-serve) — fastest; billing starts immediately when you enable card.
2) Purchase Order (PO) / Net-30 invoicing — requires PO + vendor onboarding paperwork (W-9, vendor form).
3) Cloud Marketplace — consolidated billing, can be preferred if you want a single contract across vendors; depends on your AP policy.

To get Helix ready for trial->paid conversion we recommend confirming:
- Preferred payment path (card / PO / marketplace)
- Trial success criteria (we can lock the metrics above or adjust)
- Target billing start date if trial converts (e.g., first of a month helps with invoicing)

Attached: redwood-trial-terms-v1.pdf (trial checklist + sample SOW).

If PO is the route, can you share your procurement contact and the internal timeline? If card, we can enable a payment link today. Either way, I’ll loop in Monica (on procurement ops) to accelerate paperwork.

Proposed short next steps:
- You confirm payment path and any required finance docs by Apr 22
- If PO: Helix sends PO and procurement packet by Apr 25 -> target billing start May 1
- Schedule 30m wrap-up call if you'd like Monica to walk procurement steps live

Thanks — I’ll stand by for the preferred route.

Hi Kyle — copying the procurement checklist below and attaching our onboarding packet to speed Finance approvals.

What Redwood needs for a PO / Net-30 flow:
- Completed vendor form (you already attached — thanks).
- Signed PO referencing Redwood invoice terms and quote number (I can provide a quote PDF once we finalize pricing).
- W-9 (US entities) or equivalent tax form for non-US vendors.
- Contact and email for your AP team to receive invoices + remittance address.

Timeline estimates (typical):
- Team returns vendor form + W-9 -> 1–2 business days for Redwood to generate quote and invoice header
- Helix issues PO -> Finance processes within 5–10 business days (depends on internal approvals)

Notes on trial conversion / billing:
- If Helix executes PO by Apr 26 and the PO references a May 1 start date, we can target May 1 for billing to commence.
- Trial pricing: we will bill at the agreed list-rate unless we have an approved commercial discount attached to the quote (please flag if you need pricing approval now).
- Marketplace: if you confirm marketplace as the route, please let us know which marketplace SKU you’ll use (we’ll share SKU mapping). Marketplace typically adds 3–5 business days for procurement alignment but gives you consolidated invoicing.

Attached: vendor_onboarding_packet.docx (contains sample quote template, W-9 instructions, and billing contacts).
